description: Run a command from a local or remote npm package.

option.name: --allow-scripts
tip: Comma-separated list of packages whose install-time lifecycle scripts should be allowed to run.

option.name: --call
tip: Run the command in a shell.

option.name: --dangerously-allow-all-scripts
tip: If true, bypass the allowScripts policy entirely and run every install script.

option.name: --include-workspace-root
tip: Include the workspace root when workspaces are enabled for a command.

option.name: --package
tip: The package or packages to install and run.

option.name: --strict-allow-scripts
tip: If true, turn the install-script policy from a warning into a hard failure.

option.name: --workspace
tip: Enable running a command in the context of the configured workspaces.

option.name: --workspaces
tip: Set to true to run the command in the context of all configured workspaces.
